attracted massive research as electrode materials for supercapacitors. Here, O, N, and P co-doped porous carbon 
sheets (ONPC) were developed by one-step activation way using sunflower straw as the carbon source,

1. Introduction 
Supercapacitors with super high power density, speedy charge- 
discharge rate, and exceptional operation life have emerged widely 
concerned in recent years [1 – 5] . According to the energy storage 
mechanisms, supercapacitors can be classified into pseudocapacitors 
and electric double layer capacitors. Compared with pseudocapacitors, 
electric double-layer capacitors exhibit higher cycle life and better rate 
performance. Activated carbon is the preferred electrode material for 
the commercialization of supercapacitors because of its big specific 
surface area, cheap cost, and good electrochemical stabilization [6 – 9] . 
Nevertheless, activated carbon is usually mainly composed of micro -
pores, which faces long ion migration distance, high ion migration 
resistance, and poor conductivity [10 – 12] . As a result, the electro -
chemical performance of activated carbon is not satisfactory. 
Two-dimensional (2D) porous carbon sheets have attracted massive 
attention as electrode material for supercapacitors due to their great 
open smooth layer with big specific surface area, low ion migration 
distance, and short ion migration resistance [13 – 16] . Template syn -
thesis is an available method to produce 2D porous carbon sheets. For 
example, Wei et al. [17] prepared multi-mesoporous carbon nanosheets 
using Mg(OH)
2 
as the template and hydroxyquinoline-zinc complex as 
the carbon source. The synthesized carbon nanosheets exhibit a specific 
capacitance of 220 F g
� 1 
at 1 A g
� 1
. Although some results have been 
obtained, the template method requires synthesis and removal of tem -
plates, and the preparation process is tedious, time-consuming, and 
resource-consuming. 
Recently, the preparation of two-dimensional porous carbon sheets 
from biomass shows prominent development prospects due to its simple 
technology, cheap cost, and good electrochemical performance [18 – 21] . 
Wang et al. [22] developed porous carbon sheets (PCs) by carbonization 
treatment of corn straw, NaCl, and KCl in air atmosphere. The synthe -
sized PCs deliver a specific capacitance of 407 F g
� 1 
at 1 A g
� 1
. Du et al. 
[23] synthesized nitrogen-rich porous carbon sheets (N-PC) by acti -
vating carrots with Na

SiO
3
. The obtained materials deliver a specific 
capacitance of 268 F g

not only increase the electron transfer ability and provide additional 
pseudocapacitance, but also construct functional groups on the exterior 
of carbon materials to enhance the wettability [24 – 26] . On the other 
hand, since some heteroatoms can enter the carbon materials in a special 
configuration, the active sites are increased, which provides the possi -
bility for improving the energy storage properties and further improve

use biomass as precursor to prepare heteroatom doping porous carbon

Sunflower is widely planted in the world, and its straw has become 
the main waste and incineration object of farmland, which causes 
environmental pollution and waste of resources. Transforming biolog -
ical waste sunflower straw into high performance electrode materials for 
supercapacitors can not only effectively alleviate environmental prob -
lems, but also become a treasure to achieve efficient utilization of re -
sources. In this paper, O, N, and P co-doped porous carbon sheets were 
prepared by a one-step activation method using sunflower straw as the 
carbon source, NH

broaden the voltage window, which is beneficial to improve the energy

However, not only micropores have a positive effect on the capacitance, 
mesopores can provide an effective channel for charge transfer, so an 
appropriate pore size ratio can significantly improve the performance of 
the materials. The pore size distribution curve of the carbon material 
was obtained by DFT method. As shown in Fig. 3 b, all samples possess 
abundant micropores center at about 0.8 nm and 1.2 nm. Furthermore, 
some mesopores center at about 2 – 4 nm were observed. 
The electrochemical characteristic of the prepared samples was 
evaluated using a three-electrode system in 6 M KOH electrolyte. As 
shown in Fig. 4 a, the cyclic voltammetry (CV) curves of the PC-700, 
ONC-700 and ONPC-x electrodes exhibit a quasi-rectangular configu -
ration at 50 mV s
� 1

layer capacitance. In addition, a wide and paltry redox peak can be 
noticed in the CV curve of ONPC-600 ( Fig. S4a ), ONPC-700, ONPC-800 
( Fig. S4c ), which proves that the surface heteroatom functional group of 
the carbon materials providing additional pseudocapacitance.
